import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*(a|b|TMP)\s*<-\s*(-?\d+)\s*;\s*$")

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith("//"):
        continue

    match = assignment.match(line)
    if match:
        name, value = match.groups()
        values[name] = int(value)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
